title.value: Calibration and generalizability of probabilistic models on low-data chemical datasets with DIONYSUS
title.justification: The title accurately captures the main focus of the paper, which is the calibration and generalizability of probabilistic models on low-data chemical datasets using the DIONYSUS framework.
title.quote: Calibration and generalizability of probabilistic models on low-data chemical datasets with DIONYSUS

extractions.description: The paper explores the calibration and generalizability of probabilistic machine learning models on small chemical datasets. It assesses molecular representations and models for predicting molecular properties and uncertainties across various tasks. Two experiments—Bayesian optimization guided molecular design and inference on out-of-distribution data via cluster splits—are introduced to evaluate model performance. Insights into model and feature choice for modeling small chemical datasets are presented, and the DIONYSUS software package is introduced to aid in analysis and extension to new datasets.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central focus of the paper is on the development and evaluation of machine learning models for small chemical datasets, rather than specific applications to climate or ecological sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this work we perform an extensive study of the calibration and generalizability of probabilistic machine learning models on small chemical datasets.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not address climate or ecologically-related sustainable development objectives directly. It focuses on probabilistic models and machine learning techniques applicable to chemical datasets without specific ties to ecological or climate issues.
primary_category.quote: The design and discovery of molecular materials routinely enables technologies which have crucial societal consequences.

secondary_categories.justification: There are no secondary themes explicitly related to Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development in the paper.
secondary_categories.quote: Deep learning models that leverage large datasets are often the state of the art for modelling molecular properties.

primary_sub_category.justification: The focus is on general machine learning and modeling techniques rather than a specific sub-category related to climate or ecological sustainability.
primary_sub_category.quote: We offer practical insights into model and feature choice for modelling small chemical datasets, a common scenario in new chemical experiments.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: No specific sub-categories within Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development are discussed.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Therefore, building accurate quantitative structure-activity relationship models (QSAR) is key to accelerated chemical design and efficient experimental decision-making.

applications.justification: This application is highlighted as one of the experiments conducted using the probabilistic models, relevant to enhancing molecular design processes.
applications.quote: We also introduce two simulated experiments that evaluate their performance: (1) Bayesian optimization guided molecular design.

applications.value: Inference on out-of-distribution data via ablated cluster splits
applications.justification: This is another experiment aimed at assessing model performance on unseen data that doesn't conform to the original data distribution, important for extending utility in new scenarios.
applications.quote: (2) inference on out-of-distribution data via ablated cluster splits.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper's content fits within the typical domain of chemical and machine learning research, not necessitating a new category within climate or ecological contexts.
new_primary_category.quote: Deep learning models are able to extract statistical patterns in dataset features and give accurate QSAR predictions and classifications.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: No new sub-category is required as the paper focuses on existing methodologies in machine learning rather than specific sustainability topics.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Using different molecular representations and models, we analyse the quality of their predictions and uncertainties in a variety of tasks (binary, regression) and datasets.
